This document 
outlines the checklist P1 for QRO card, 
which must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above 
title block

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the 
suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety helmet and shoes.
Unit must be shutdown.
Check that all power source at MCC for the unit auxiliaries are disconnected.
Safety helmet, shoes,
Hand held Radio, wireless communications means.
Ohm-meter.
Screw Driver, Nut Driver,
Isolating tape, and test leads.

Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU Cabinet.

Using 
 cabinet termination identify the location for the desired Card.
Using cabinet Termination list for each card identify the three input wires for the first channel

Using the screw driver, remove the two wires and 
 isolate by tape.
Connect the ohm-meter leads to the first channel.

Using radio from CCR make start or stop command according to the termination 
 list.
Watch the ohm-meter reading to see the contact closed or opened.
If the reading is Ok, repeat steps 1 to 5 for the another 7 channels.
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the Card.

Remove the 
 ohm-meter leads.

Reconnect 
 the input wires to terminal strip.

Close the 
 cabinet.

Place a copy 
 of test result in the field maintenance file.

Introduction
QRO is a Digital 
Output Card of 8 Channels output to Start Stop Equpment
This document 
outlines the checklist P1 for QRO card, 
which must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above 
title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed 
Esmail Fouad & eng. Khalil Ahmed Awwad, QAV
tested at 10 
June 2002, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abdel Menem Al Emam, 
accepted by general
director: eng Mohamed Abdel Ghafar, and approved by 
eng. Yosery 
Mohamed Salama Head Sector of EL-Aresh Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the 
suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety helmet and shoes.
Unit must be shutdown.
Check that all power source at MCC for the unit auxiliaries are disconnected.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, shoes,
Hand held Radio, wireless communications means.
Ohm-meter.
Screw Driver, Nut Driver,
Isolating tape, and test leads.
Work to be Carried Out
Steps to 
Prepare for test
Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU Cabinet.
Using 
 cabinet termination identify the location for the desired Card.
Start Test
Using cabinet Termination list for each card identify the three input wires for the first channel
Using the screw driver, remove the two wires and 
 isolate by tape.
Connect the ohm-meter leads to the first channel.
Using radio from CCR make start or stop command according to the termination 
 list.
Watch the ohm-meter reading to see the contact closed or opened.
If the reading is Ok, repeat steps 1 to 5 for the another 7 channels.
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the Card.
Return Card to 
Service
Remove the 
 ohm-meter leads.
Reconnect 
 the input wires to terminal strip.
Close the 
 cabinet.
Place a copy 
 of test result in the field maintenance file.
